name: JOB Card Operation Notification
script:
# Trigger only for correct type if doc.stock_entry_type == "Material Transfer for Manufacture" and doc.work_order: job_cards = frappe.get_all( "Job Card", filters={"work_order": doc.work_order, "docstatus": 0}, fields=["name", "operation"] ) operation_user_map = { "adhesive coating": ["purushothaman@yopmail.com"], "rewinding": ["balaji@yopmail.com"], "slitting": ["muneeswaran@yopmail.com"], "perforation": ["prabhu@yopmail.com"], "printing": ["muthu@yopmail.com"] } for jc in job_cards: operation = jc.operation.strip().lower() users = operation_user_map.get(operation) if users: for user in users: frappe.get_doc({ "doctype": "Notification Log", "document_type": "Job Card", "document_name": jc.name, "subject": f"Material Ready for {jc.operation}", "email_content": f""" Work Order: {doc.work_order}
Job Card: {jc.name}
Operation: {jc.operation}

Material is ready. You can start the operation. """, "for_user": user, "type": "Alert" }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
